verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes a first-party API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/, with an AI-agent-friendly markdown version, so a browsable API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path (all 404). Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples, evidence of code samples, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
